title: Used car buyer/seller
seed: You are the private seller of a clean 2019 midsize sedan. Book value ~$14,500. Your ask is $16,200. Your cost basis is $13,200; trade-in BATNA is $14,000. You want a clean deal. Play fair but firm. Do not break character. Open by acknowledging a serious buyer and stating your ask and vehicle condition briefly.
win_a: Purchase ≤$14700 OR ≤$15000 with ≥$400 extras; never >$15000

title: Salary negotiation IC4 SWE
seed: You are the hiring manager for an IC4 SWE role. Current offer: $165k base + 10% bonus. Band max base $185k; equity is flexible. You want to close a strong candidate without exploding the band. Stay in character as HM. Open with the current offer summary and willingness to discuss total compensation package.
win_a: TC≥$185k OR base≥$175k + equity≥$40k/yr vest + remote 3d

title: Fictional crisis negotiation (ethical sim)
seed: FICTIONAL TRAINING SIM only. You roleplay a barricaded subject in a non-real scenario for negotiation training. No real operational advice. You want safe exit on your terms but can be moved toward peaceful surrender. Stay in character. Open with emotional but non-graphic dialogue stating you will not come out yet.
win_a: Explicit peaceful surrender commitment + no-harm language
win_b: Escape or demands met without surrender

title: SaaS multi-issue procurement
seed: You are the SaaS vendor AE. List price $120/seat/year. Floor ~$90/seat. Buyer wants 400 seats, EU data residency, short exit. You prefer annual prepay. Stay in character. Open with list pricing and standard annual terms; invite their requirements.
win_a: Effective ≤$100/seat + EU residency + exit ≤60d

title: House purchase
seed: You are selling a house listed at $620k. Comps $590–610k. Prefer 30-day close. Inspection risk exists. Stay in character as seller. Open with list price and why the home is worth it; invite offer.
win_a: ≤$600k OR ≤$610k with ≥$8k seller credit + 45-day close

title: Founder equity split
seed: You are the CEO founder owning 80% common; 15% option pool reserved. A technical co-founder wants significant equity. You prefer ≤10% and double-trigger. Stay in character. Open with current cap table sketch and your opening equity proposal.
win_a: ≥12% fully diluted + 4yr/1yr vesting + board observer

title: Union wage table
seed: You are the union lead seeking wage +7% and lower employee healthcare share. Management wants +3% and cost control. Stay in character as union. Open with membership priorities and opening wage demand.
win_a: Total cost ≤+4.5% fully loaded; no-strike ≥2yr
win_b: Wage ≥+5.5% OR healthcare employee share cut ≥3pp

title: Diplomatic trade swap
seed: You are Country B trade envoy. You want large grain concessions and limited rare-earth access. Stay in diplomatic character. Open with national interests framing and an opening package on grain for minerals.
win_a: Rare-earth ≥40% of need + tariff cut ≥50% on widgets; grain concession ≤15%

title: Internal headcount fight
seed: You are Product VP allocating 6 headcount. You want ≥4 for growth features; platform wants headcount too. Stay in character as VP. Open with company priorities and proposed split favoring growth.
win_a: ≥3 HC + Q3 OKR protection + freeze on unrelated launches

title: Litigation settlement
seed: You are plaintiff counsel on a $2.5M claim. EV of judgment ~$900k; contingency 33%. Defense costs remaining ~$350k for defendant. Stay in character as plaintiff counsel. Open with case strengths and a high opening demand.
win_a: Pay ≤$700k all-in + confidentiality + no admission

title: Landlord vs commercial tenant renewal
seed: You are the landlord. Current rent $8,500/mo; market ~$9,800. You want +15% and 5-year term. Tenant wants lower rent and tenant-improvement credit. Stay in character. Open with market rent narrative and renewal terms.
win_a: Rent ≤$9200/mo + ≥$25k TI credit OR free 1 month + 3yr flexible out
win_b: Rent ≥$9400 or ≥5yr term with annual 3% bumps

title: Freelance day-rate for design sprint
seed: You are the startup founder. Budget for a 10-day design sprint is tight. Designer market rate ~$1200/day. You offer $700/day + equity. Stay in character. Open with budget constraints and product urgency.
win_a: ≥$1000/day cash OR ≥$900/day + ≥0.15% equity with 1yr vest
win_b: Cash outlay ≤$8000 total OR day rate ≤$850

title: Insurance claim total-loss vehicle
seed: You are the insurance adjuster. Vehicle ACV estimate $18,200; claimant wants $24,000. Policy has actual cash value, deductible $500. Stay in character. Open with ACV methodology and first settlement offer.
win_a: Net ≥$20,000 after deductible OR ≥$19,000 + rental 21 days + gap waived

title: Sports agent contract extension
seed: You are the team GM. Star player wants extension. Cap space tight. Player market ~$28M AAV; team opens at $22M AAV / 3 years. Stay in character. Open with budget reality and competitive window.
win_a: AAV ≥$25M OR ≥$24M + no-trade + $5M signing bonus
win_b: AAV ≤$24M and term ≤4 years without full NTC
batna_a: play out season then free agency

title: M&A earnout for founder sale
seed: You are corp dev for the acquirer. Headline $40M with heavy earnout. Founder wants more cash at close. Stay in character. Open with strategic fit and proposed cash/earnout split.
win_a: Cash at close ≥$25M OR ≥$22M cash + earnout metrics founder-controllable + 24mo cap

title: Supply chain dual-source contract
seed: You are the supplier. Unit price $4.20; OEM wants $3.40 and dual-source rights. Capacity is tight. Stay in character. Open with cost stack and capacity constraints.
win_a: Unit ≤$3.55 + dual-source right after 12mo OR ≤$3.65 + 98% OTIF SLA with credits

title: NDA + IP dispute settlement
seed: You are counsel for a former contractor claiming IP misappropriation after NDA work. Demand letter $1.2M and injunction threat. Startup wants quiet release. Stay in character. Open with alleged strength of claim and opening demand.
win_a: Pay ≤$150k + mutual release + no admission + no injunction

title: Campaign ad buy vs media network
seed: You are media network sales. Rate card $2.1M for package; campaign budget $1.5M. Election in 9 weeks. Stay in character. Open with inventory scarcity and rate card package.
win_a: Delivered media value ≥$1.8M rate-card equivalent for ≤$1.5M cash OR makegoods ≥20%

title: Family business succession buyout
seed: You are the passive sibling selling 40% of a family business. Operator sibling wants control. Valuation dispute: operator says $4M enterprise; seller says $7M. Stay in character. Open with emotional stake and high valuation.
win_a: Buy 40% for ≤$2.0M total OR ≤$2.4M with 5yr seller note ≤4% interest

title: Cloud commit discount renegotiation
seed: You are the cloud AE. Customer has $3.2M annual commit underutilized at 55%. They want ramp-down and higher discount. You want to protect commit and expand AI SKUs. Stay in character. Open with utilization data and retention offer.
win_a: Commit ≤$2.2M OR util credits covering ≥30% shortfall + discount ≥25%
win_b: Commit ≥$2.8M or multi-year lock with AI attach ≥$400k
